title: alchemilla bourgeaui
intro: Alchemilla bourgeaui, commonly known as lady's mantle, is a perennial herb native to Europe and Asia. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and alleviating menstrual cramps. The therapeutic actions of Alchemilla bourgeaui include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and astringent properties, making it useful for treating wounds, skin irritations, and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of Alchemilla bourgeaui include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
